name: Meta Ads weekly account keeper
why: Runs the weekly routine from your exports: a true-return check, a scale-or-hold call and a change list to approve.

name: Meta Ads 30-check account auditor
why: A scored audit across tracking, creative, structure and audiences, to pair with the account audit skill.

name: Meta server tracking checker
why: Picks the right server route and checks for double counting, the first thing to fix before any spend decision.

name: Meta concept diversity test planner
why: Sorts your ads into concept types, spots gaps and tired ads, and plans the next creative test round.

name: Ad fatigue watcher
why: Catches tired ads early twice a week and writes a brief for each replacement.

name: Ad test sprint runner
why: Plans each test round, reads it when it ends and plans the next, so testing never stalls.

name: Meta account structure planner
why: Lays out a simple campaign and ad set structure with budgets that can get through learning.

name: Meta delivery troubleshooter
why: Finds where delivery is failing when ads will not spend or results suddenly stop.

name: Platform ROAS reality check
why: Compares Meta's reported ROAS with your store totals to give a truer return before you scale.

name: Break-even ROAS and CPA calculator
why: Works out the most you can pay per sale from price and margin, the number every decision is judged against.

name: Meta ads compliance checker
why: Checks an ad against Meta's ad rules before launch and rewrites risky lines.

name: Creative hit rate planner
why: Measures how many new concepts beat your profit line, so you know how much creative to make.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: A monthly check across analytics and ad platforms that catches broken tracking and double counts.
